title: PPP cold-start convergence with a TEP clock prior (degraded geometry)

geometry.note: clean full-sky phase PPP is observation-limited on the clock; the operational niche is GPS-only / high-elevation / k-thinned

prior_sigma_note: TEP arm: per-epoch sigma from step_22 (base ~0.696 m, modulated ±30% by TEP astronomical phases via tep_process_noise_scale). Persistence arm: flat sigma = 0.696 m. Base from sqrt(1 - 0.64) * 1.16 m, Step 58.
trend_note: For each cold-start window starting at t0, the prior's absolute trend is fit only to target rck data with sod <= t0, removing the full-day look-ahead bias.  A persistence control (target-only causal linear extrapolation, no network) is run at the same sigma.
